author: Mark Atwood
text: Idiom rating (2nd rusty pass, supplementing the 1st at 2026-05-14 03:22): ACCEPTABLE — the 1st pass's verdict stands. The 2nd pass filed 7 supplementary findings (.52-.58) focused on the gaps the 1st pass explicitly flagged in its confidence note: memory.rs (3121 lines, entirely skipped) and clippy::pedantic (never run). Findings break down as: 1 gratuitous-allocation pattern in memory.rs hot-path lookups (.52, P2, propagation candidate), 1 unsafe-cast cluster on i64/u64/usize boundaries (.53, P3, 32-bit-only impact), 1 manual_let_else sweep across 17 sites (.54, P3, mechanical), 1 items_after_statements hit on three module-scope-sized const arrays buried inside a 363-line function (.55, P3), 1 rustdoc polish sweep covering 93+49+11=153 lints (.56, P3), 1 cfg-arm tuple-suppression nit (.57, P4 opinion), and 1 workspace-canonical-template question on the four ~400-line /set handlers (.58, P3). None of the 7 are correctness or soundness issues; all are readability / maintainability / pre-publish polish. The cookie-cutter propagation lens fires on at least .52, .54, .56 (and arguably .58); a senior reviewer would want a coordinated sweep across jmap-mail-server first, not isolated chat-server fixes. Combined-pass total: 13 idiomatic-rust findings (6 from pass 1 plus 7 from pass 2). At this point the diminishing-returns curve is steep — a 3rd rusty pass would mostly turn up clippy::nursery noise and bikeshedding.
